rationale: Binds review calls to the inputs that determine their existing admission policy. Read-only tool arguments no longer cause false audit refusals after native normalization; Write, fixed checks and structured output retain complete canonical input binding. Journal identity, decisions, results, material and publication checks remain mandatory. Product behavior is unchanged and historical refusals gain no authority.

summary.ru: Разрешённое чтение больше не срывает ревью из-за нормализации аргументов native CLI; запись и исполнение сохраняют точную сверку.
summary.en: Native read-argument normalization no longer aborts admitted reviews; writes and execution retain exact input checks.
